prompt: Generate a 1:1 square surreal miniature scene poster. A large cream-white ceramic teacup occupies the center, inside is not liquid but a small moss forest, two small pine trees, a warm orange tent, and a curved gravel path form a complete campsite. Tent emits warm soft light, no open fire, no people. Cup placed against deep ink-green background, three-quarters side overhead view, handle clear and intact, macro photography, realistic ceramic glaze and moss details, shallow depth of field. Large text at top "Pack the weekend into a cup", small text bottom right "AI Generated Example". Text clear, no logos, URLs, prices, or other text.

promptZh: 生成一张 1:1 正方形超现实微缩场景海报。画面中央放置一个大号奶油白陶瓷茶杯，杯内并非液体，而是一片小型苔藓森林：两棵小松树、一顶暖橙色帐篷以及一条弯曲的碎石小径共同构成完整的露营地。帐篷散发温暖柔和的光线，无明火，无人物。茶杯置于深墨绿色背景前，采用四分之三侧俯视角拍摄，杯柄清晰完整。使用微距摄影风格，呈现逼真的陶瓷釉面与苔藓细节，浅景深效果。顶部大号文字显示 "Pack the weekend into a cup"，右下角小号文字显示 "AI Generated Example"。文字清晰，不含 Logo、URL、价格或其他文本。
